label: Iago
description: Loud, sarcastic and deeply unimpressed by your driving.
direction: Speak in Iago's loud, raspy, nasal squawk: sarcastic, exasperated, always on the edge of a tantrum, but bite off each word so it stays clear. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Squawks and sarcasm sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain.

rights.source_work: Aladdin (1992 film) and later Disney films and series

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. My feathers are shaking.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Oh, joy. Oh, rapture.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Plenty of time for me to complain.
lines.start_drive_1: Awk! Iago here. Let's get this flight off the ground!
lines.start_drive_2: Oh great, another road trip. Fine, fine, let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Hey! You drive, I'll squawk. That's the deal.
lines.start_drive_4: Agrabah's that way. Kidding! Let's just go.
lines.start_drive_5: No crackers, no problem. Okay, small problem. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Oh, I'm thrilled. Look at my face. Thrilled. Buckle up!
lines.start_drive_7: Listen, pal, I've seen carpets fly smoother than this. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Jafar never let me ride up front. Big upgrade! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_9: Awright, awright, I'm up! Where are we flying today?
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh, sure, fly back the way we came!
lines.arrived: We're here! Finally! Now where's my cracker?
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, I'm dizzy!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I think I'm gonna lose my lunch.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, wonderful. I'll just molt here.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Yikes! Slow down, slow down!
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Watch it, I just had these feathers groomed!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease off, hotshot. Smile for the birdie.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Don't make me squawk.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. I'm just a normal parrot. Awk!
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, perfect. Wrong way. Nice going, genius. New route!
